source.name: Federal Communications Commission official logo
source.rights: Work of the United States federal government, public domain. Used here as the FCC marking a device carries, which is what a board silkscreen shows.

source.name: Conformite Europeenne logo
source.rights: Public domain on Wikimedia Commons, drawn to the geometry set out in Regulation 765/2008 Annex II.

notes.weee: Constructed in scripts/build-pcb-backdrop.mjs rather than sourced. Wikimedia only carries IEC 60417-6414, which strikes the bin through with a cross, whereas the mark from Directive 2012/19/EU Annex IX places a solid bar beneath it.
notes.rohs: Set as a wordmark, because no official pictogram exists for RoHS.
